findings.title: m9_memory.sh step 2 re-measures the 2p priority configurations
findings.detail: KEY_FIELDS excludes val_pass, so f0d1 T7 N 3/4/5 with $KNOBS and --val-pair-chunk 4 has the same record key in step 2p and step 2. Step 2 re-runs them (about 18-30 min), and a hard-crashed re-run child makes the parent write an 'error' record that replaces the good 2p record (measure_isolated + write_merged). Drop those N at T 7 for the center widths from step 2, or skip keys already recorded as 'ok'.

findings.title: Retraining plan is only a one-line pointer in report.md
findings.detail: The R5 section of report.md names design-m9-phase1.md 6.4 but gives none of the plan. Add the level 4 -> 2 -> 1 summary (script, group sizes, steps, GPU, wall time) so Jay can review it from the report.

findings.title: Recommended config exceeds the budget under the forward bound with margin
findings.detail: f0d1 LS N 4: deform_peak_fwd_bound_margin_gib 44.39 > 44 GiB (documented; fallback lean_losses true, measured in step 3). Check this case in the cluster results before fixing deform N 4.
